profiles.pskernel-core.old3: Existing host/worker adapters, generated foundation.js, package metadata and BUILD.json. The observed generated file must match the currently selected owned-provider identity.
profiles.pskernel-core: Host adapter and the exact selected native executable. The selected path is passed explicitly to the checker invocation.

rules: Capture selected regular-file bytes before checking; compare the same explicit file set after checking, before a live checked handle can be returned.
Resolve native executable selection once; ambient executable overrides cannot silently select a different path for that invocation.
Dual-check builds capture and bind both selected providers; this does not assert independent implementations.
Bind each provider manifest to the acceptance context and checking action. Retain every referenced file byte in the observed build archive.
Check-only receipts retain explicit file-digest observations; they do not contain a byte archive or mint transferable authority.
The existing archive budgets still apply to combined compiler/tool/provider artifacts; oversized combinations fail before final publication.
remaining: host runtime, OS libraries and ambient environment
unlisted dynamic inputs and complete generated-compiler execution closure
source-binary correspondence and authenticated release provenance
actual independent/diverse checking and global checker soundness
authority: Byte observations bind the recorded invocation under trusted host/filesystem assumptions. Offline archive integrity replay does not execute the checker, replay kernel acceptance, establish semantic preservation or promote security/bootstrap assurance.
